summary: Iteration 9 — full backend + frontend validation of the new auth flows (change-password, forgot/reset-password, real account deletion, admin role in /auth/me) and the new i18n/Settings/Forgot/Legal screens. Backend: 18/18 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_9.py covering (a) POST /api/auth/change-password happy + wrong-current (401) + unauth (401) + old-pw-no-longer-logs-in + new session_token issued; (b) POST /api/auth/forgot-password non-enumerating (ok:true for unknown AND known email) and stores bcrypt-hashed 6-digit code with 15-min expiry, attempts=0; (c) POST /api/auth/reset-password wrong code=400, expired=400, attempts≥5=429, happy path (via directly inserted known bcrypt hash) succeeds, revokes old sessions, new password logs in; (d) DELETE /api/auth/account anonymizes user (email->deleted_<uid>@trace.deleted, password_hash=None, deleted_at set), purges library/discoveries/collections, revokes sessions, blocks subsequent login (401), and allows same email to be re-registered (200); (e) regression: register/login/me now returns role='user', /discoveries text auto-saves, /library with media_type/watch_status/sort filters, /library/genres/list, /collections CRUD + batch-add + delete, /search returns 200. Frontend (390×844): full walk-through with fresh registered account iter9_1788896632@gmail.com. All flows PASS: register→home, 5 tabs navigate (Home/Library/Lists/Search/Profile — using text fallback because tabBarTestID does not surface on RN-Web, per iter8), Profile→Settings opens, EN↔TR language toggle switches instantly AND persists after page reload, TR tab bar shows 'Ana Sayfa / Kütüphane / Listeler / Ara / Profil' (no English leftover in bottom nav HTML), TR Settings shows fully-Turkish labels (ŞİFRE DEĞİŞTİR, YASAL VE GİZLİLİK, Kullanım Koşulları, Gizlilik Politikası ve KVKK, HESABI SİL, 'Hesabımı sil') plus 'Dil Türkçe olarak ayarlandı' success toast, change-password form submits + toast + old-pw session invalidated + login with new password succeeds, Terms of Service opens with full body (945 chars), Privacy Policy & KVKK opens with 'KVKK' text present, delete-account confirm step reveals cancel/confirm pair and Cancel correctly hides the confirmation, Forgot Password from login opens 2-step screen (email → code+newpass), wrong code POST returns 400 and error surfaces in UI, back-to-login navigation works. Zero page errors, zero red screens; console noise limited to expected pre-auth 401 on /auth/me at boot and one 400 from the wrong-code reset attempt.

action_items: Optional hardening: /api/auth/forgot-password currently prints 'Password reset requested but email service not configured' only when EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY is missing. In current .env the key IS present so real emails are sent — main agent already verified via delivered@resend.dev.
Optional: consider surfacing a testID on /api/auth/reset-password error banner in forgot.tsx (currently the 'err' Text has no testID, tests rely on innerText scan). Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py change-password: correctly revokes ALL user_sessions and issues a new session_token — old bearer token becomes invalid. Verified end-to-end.

backend/server.py forgot-password: correctly non-enumerating (both known & unknown emails return {ok:true}); rate-limits attempts to 5 then purges; bcrypt-hashes the 6-digit code; 15-min expiry. Also correctly skips non-email accounts (Google auth).

backend/server.py delete-account: soft-delete via deleted_at + PII anonymization (email→deleted_<uid>@trace.deleted, name='Deleted user', picture=None, password_hash=None) AND hard-delete of user_sessions/discoveries/library/collections. Login is subsequently blocked because deleted_at is checked in both /auth/login and get_current_user. Same email can be re-registered because the unique-email index only sees the anonymized address. KVKK-compliant.
backend/server.py: user_sessions has expireAfterSeconds=0 TTL on expires_at — correct.

backend/services/email.py: strong safety scan (no forms/inputs, no credential-ask text, https-only absolute URLs, anchor-text host must match real href host). Fixed template on server — user input never lands in markup.

frontend/src/i18n/index.tsx: loads persisted language from storage first, falls back to device locale (Localization.getLocales), only accepts 'tr'|'en'. Nested key resolution + variable interpolation via {{var}}. Missing keys fall back to EN, then to the key string — no silent breakage.

frontend/app/settings.tsx: change-password shown only when auth_provider === 'email' (correctly hides for Google users). Delete-account correctly gated behind confirmDelete state — no accidental deletion.

frontend/app/(auth)/forgot.tsx: 2-step flow; step 1 intentionally advances even on network error (non-enumerating UX aligns with backend contract). Wrong code surfaces backend detail via e?.detail fallback.
frontend/app/legal/[doc].tsx: parametrized route with both EN and TR content bodies embedded — no server round-trip needed.

rca_of_issue: N/A — no regression detected. All new endpoints implement the exact contract described in the request (non-enumeration, bcrypt-hashed code, 15-min TTL, 5-attempt cap → 429, session revocation, PII anonymization, re-registration allowed). i18n switches update the tree via React Context (I18nCtx.Provider) which forces child re-render — verified by observing the tab bar labels change instantly and persist through page reload. The only carry-over deprecation (ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images in add-discovery.tsx:41) is unrelated to this scope.
